label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Cadhat ul sestow et flennath sy, rytet eth rytet, hosen re hethe Halyna gor hos hy et kaelirvesk eth hy et reskowath strom. El saed et flennath sa ross lo et scethan sost, hy vodh re ryt et mesk gor rytet ulo, eth nath re ryter hos.
english: *Set down at the back of this Book, one carving at a time, as {{Halyna}} knew each from the wreck-wood and the Thrones. It is the fleet's own half of the Book, for the wood cut every carving in it, and we cut none.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Gor rytet sa re hebb et mesk lor, ew hos stinel o dholm hosast; eth el o veskrivull et stinel hosast ull, hosen el rivull hald et trenn hosast. Doss noth meskrivull.
english: Every carving the wood gave us began with one stroke, and that first stroke is its root, as the first course is the root of a wall. Of roots there are ten.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rystullom lerneth et meskrivullath ul veskyl, lo et hylldhrenn eth ul et nelter, sell tevar hy veskyl galat ullen ul et meskdhrenn. Re vollom so, en sost, hy vodh lern navollat, omm o hy et garl hosen tolm thenth. Re vyskym gor voll sull fedh, eth hy ull re rytym o; eth re ston gor voll.
english: Their shapes I learned by eye, at the tide-line and in the vault, long ere I could make out anything else in the grain. The names are mine own, for a shape without a name slippeth out of the hand like a wet stone. Each I said three times ere I wrote it, and each held.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re ryt et mesk tevel veth et meskrivull. Re ryt gor hyll ul o sestow et meskrivull sost pawast, eth re hadh umo, hosen cadhant mesketh scaevur um scaevur. Hy ull, el et ryteteth hemm sost et ryteteth tevel sost, sa re dhevent hemm.
english: The young wood cut the root and naught more. Each Tide after cut the same root again, and added to it, as trees lay ring on ring. So the eldest carvings are but the youngest grown old.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy et hald, ul et hylleth desir, re yal seskyl veskrivull lom ul scaevurol haelir. Re seskym nafedh mest hy et meskrivull, hy vodh et ullen, nath hebb et mesk o veth lo et Lodhan, eth doss maver o hethyl umont, eth nath vesk hos o.
english: From the wall, in the late Tides, I could tell a root in the time a wreck taketh to roll over. More than the root I knew never, for the rest the wood giveth only to the Bonded, and it must be known, not read.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo sy nath noss veth et bisketh, hy et mesk tevel sost dem et mesk hemm sost. Et saedeth, cedh re dhovv um hedh eth amm vodh re haever et molt kylyl, re rytym so ul so reskowath. Lymment dhom rytet et mesk tevel vollath et hesperdeth: vollath dasorat lo yarlol, hosen hulter runn hemm.
english: Here are but the heads, from the youngest wood to the eldest. The parts, who waited on whom and when the heart meant to turn, I have written in their places. The seven of the young wood bear the soldiers' names, worn smooth with handling, like the haft of an old mallet.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rarr hos rellor ullen dem susk et brunn ul havul dholmard, hy Dhavow Vorr: Vorr. Re yal o rytet ul et Ommol, eth re rarr o nafedh ul lern ol hald. Ul surr et mymmyleth, re hadh et tolmard o um et sast domm, ul vodh re senn Vorrol. Nath nydhym o lont.
english: One sign more came up the mountain in a mason's pack, out of Emberhythe: *Burn*. It was cut in the Fall, and came never against our wall. In the year of the homecomings the mason laid it down on the black crust where the Burning went out. I count it not among these.

label: Romanisation · Seren’s head for it
rom: Vorr.
english: One sign more came up the mountain in a mason's pack, out of Emberhythe: *Burn*. It was cut in the Fall, and came never against our wall. In the year of the homecomings the mason laid it down on the black crust where the Burning went out. I count it not among these.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rarrant dhom rytet hy et mesk tevel, thell gor hos hy et sull hyll ul o sestow, eth dhom hy Hyll sa re rystull nycul. Nath re ryt Hyll Dasken bisk clenn, veth rysteth tunn hy wisketh rytet tevar, eth lo rask gor hos, kylyl dem varn.
english: Seven carvings came of the young wood, eight of each of the three Tides after it, and seven of the Tide that Learned Deceit. The Last Tide carved no new head, but whole morrows out of heads already cut, and at the end of each a turning for home.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hebbent et reskowath strom thell tesset sa re rytent so sost. Re lymme pa reskow strom rytet hemm, tunn, hy vodh el Fodh eth Stinel Hosel sa ross gor ullen rytet ulonta. Doss pa vurr eth vran ul dunnoth. Re hadhom gor hos hyont, eth nath re hethym hos hyont.
english: The Thrones gave eight Judgements of their own. Two Thrones carried an older carving whole, for the Wave and the Lone Stroke are the roots in which every other is written. Forty-six there are in all. Every one have I set down, and not one of them did I know.

label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Rytet Dasken · Sull Tolm ul susk et Odh
english: **The Last Note · Three Stones over the Hearth**

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Cadhat dasken hy et flenneth.
english: *Laid last of all the leaves.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Keth et tolm, Seren.
english: Hold the stone, Seren.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et vess hosast et grem sy, re vess tev ul lern vodh myskent, et sull tolm ryss myst ul susk et odh sy. Ul et cummath ew et tessyl gor fedh: Myskent nayalat; eth hosen ull re dhessent lom, amm ew lyss en. Nath re vyskym o. Re vyskym: Nath seskym.
english: On the first night of this winter a child at the front asked what they say, the three grey stones over this hearth. In the havens the answer was ever that they said naught, and so was I answered when I was small. I said it not. I said that I wist not.

label: Romanisation
rom: Gor vess hy ull, amm re yal et hellur pondul, re hethym et greller lo et tolm vimm sost. Nath re raevulom kaeveret ulo, veth et hunnatath, hy vodh nath noss brodlymmyl lo dholm. Re rytent et Mystaeri et brodath orrowen ul molt so rellorath, hy so hunnat, virr hosen es morr so rellorath. Eth re yal sull brod orrowen lom hy Wrenn.
english: Every night since, when the hall was empty, I have held the lamp to the lowest stone. No meaning sought I there, but the sounds only, for stone does not translate. The Mystaeri cut our words among their letters by the sound, as near as their letters would go. And three words of ours I had from Brenn.

label: Romanisation
rom: Gordal ul vess re yal et hellur pondul, eth re yal et vorr vimm, eth re vorr et greller dem vimm ryssyth nind somm re veskym.
english: Last night the hall was empty, and the fire was low, and the lamp burned down a finger's width while I looked.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re yal so lom, et sull ul hos fedh um et tolm vimm sost, et hunnatath virr, eth et rellorath navenn.
english: Then I had them, the three together on the lowest stone, the sounds close and the symbols wrong.

label: Romanisation · Seren’s caption
rom: Et tolm vimm sost hy et sull tolm ryss myst ul susk Odh Sell: rellorath kylet lo dhrenn et cless, eth ul molt et rellorath, sull brod orrowen, rytet hy et hunnat.
english:
::: native legend_three_stones chip
The lowest of the three grey stones over the Long Hearth: the curling letters of the edge, and among them three words of ours, cut by their sound
:::

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Hess… Helv… Sennyl…
english: *Stop… Sky… Dying…*

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo visketh et gannath domm re yal so rytet, eth nalymmet ul hos fedh eth et mesk, eth hynalat. Sull tesk re haemerent ul susk vorr dhavowlest lo Dhavow Hemm. Ul vimm so re dhyvull et Orrow um sull gostard, sa re vymment dem varn um vivenn. Um et tolm vimm sost re runnant et higileth mygurath. Eth re vesk nahos so.
english: At the feet of the black pillars they were cut, and carried off with the timber, and sold. Three generations they hung over a harbour-house fire at Eldhythe. Under them the shore laughed at three axemen, home on a spar. On the lowest the ship-masters knocked out their pipes. And no one read them.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo sy nath drunn hos mygur umont. Kaeverym: re veskym so. Myskym: kaeverym.
english: Here no pipe is knocked on them. I think I have read them. I say I think.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*
